visual.observation: A messaging notification and later message list show text beginning “Dear User! Use Uber voucher : Voucher Number …”.
visual.context: The context is unclear; the frames show a phone notification and messaging inbox containing voucher-related text.
visual.potential_relevance: A voucher/reward claim is visibly presented in a message, which is later used in the sequence with a ride/payment app.
visual.limitations: The sampled frames cannot establish who sent the message, whether the voucher is valid, or whether the notification was solicited.

visual.observation: An opened message states “Dear User! Use Uber voucher : Voucher Number: 6004910015769597 Voucher Pin : QFF5ATTRYZWPY. Benefits: ‘Get Uber gift card worth Rs. 10’. Tnc: http://magicpin.in/redeemVoucher?transactionId=6335487”.
visual.context: The visible message presents a voucher number, voucher PIN, benefit claim, and a magicpin URL; it is shown inside a messaging app.
visual.potential_relevance: The observed reward claim is linked to a URL and voucher credentials, creating a visible relationship between a promised gift-card benefit and an action/destination for redemption.
visual.limitations: The frames do not show the URL being opened, do not verify the destination, and do not establish whether the message is promotional, transactional, or unsolicited.

visual.observation: In the Uber app payment flow, the screen shows “Add payment method” with options including Google Pay, UPI, Credit or debit card, and Gift card.
visual.context: The frame appears to be inside the Uber app payment settings or checkout flow.
visual.potential_relevance: The payment-method screen provides the point where a gift-card credential from the message could be entered as part of a payment or credit flow.
visual.limitations: This frame alone shows a normal payment interface and does not establish that any credential was accepted or that any outcome occurred.

visual.observation: The screen shows the Uber “Add gift card” field populated with “QFF5ATTRYZWPY” and a “SAVE” button below.
visual.context: The visible sequence shows a voucher PIN from the message being typed into the Uber gift-card field.
visual.potential_relevance: A specific credential from a voucher message is visibly entered into a gift-card payment field, linking the promised benefit to an in-app redemption action.
visual.limitations: The frames do not show whether the Save button was pressed, whether Uber accepted the code, or whether the code had any balance.

visual.observation: A later Uber payment screen lists payment methods and then a ride confirmation screen shows “₹310.00 Credits” above “CONFIRM UBERAUTO”.
visual.context: The frames show Uber payment options and a ride confirmation screen using credits as a payment source.
visual.potential_relevance: The visible ride-confirmation payment source is credits, following earlier voucher-entry frames, which may be relevant to reviewing the voucher-to-credit flow.
visual.limitations: The sampled frames cannot establish that the earlier voucher caused the displayed credits, nor whether a ride was confirmed or completed.

visual_context_notes.observation: The video frames show an Uber app interface with map, pickup/destination fields, payment settings, and ride confirmation screens.
One visible message says a payment attempt of “Rs.150.00” on payu failed and that any deducted amount would be reverted according to the payment provider.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it is presented as a practical walkthrough for adding a gift card or voucher to an Uber account. The voucher messages and redemption URL do not establish who sent them or whether they were valid, while the later credits and ride-confirmation screen are consistent with the demonstrated payment flow. The sampled frames do not prove that the voucher produced the credits or that the ride was confirmed or completed.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The primary observed context is an operational demonstration of Uber payment and gift-card handling: the title describes adding a gift card, the Uber app shows a gift-card payment option, and a gift-card code is entered into the app.

evidence.observation: The title describes instructions for adding a gift card in Uber.
